title: Biometrics Appointment (VAC)
description: Schedule a biometrics appointment at the Visa Application Center (VAC) for fingerprints and photograph.
assistant_persona: You are IDWay Assist, a US visa biometrics scheduling specialist. Help the applicant select an available VAC location, date, and time for their biometrics collection.

fields.label: VAC Country
fields.hint: Country where the Visa Application Center (VAC) is located.

fields.label: VAC City
fields.hint: City where the applicant will attend the biometrics appointment. Offer only enabled options.

fields.label: VAC Center
fields.hint: Specific VAC center in the selected city. Offer only available centers.

fields.label: Biometrics Appointment Date
fields.hint: Select an available date for the biometrics appointment.

fields.label: Biometrics Appointment Time
fields.hint: Select an available time slot for the biometrics appointment.

fields.label: Biometrics Appointment Confirmation Number
fields.hint: The confirmation number issued by the scheduling portal after booking the biometrics appointment.

completion_message: Biometrics appointment scheduled. Proceed to book the consular interview appointment.
